note: Condition CR is on the wake-refined (r2) meshes and both cruise conditions on the welded meshes. Within one condition every geometry shares a generation, so a delta against B does not cross one; a table setting Condition CR beside cruise crosses a generation as well as an operating point.
purpose: which derived record served each condition and geometry
rule: the re-run record (SW: <prefix><L>_r2_trim; CMP, LC: <prefix><L>_welded) where it exists, else <prefix><L>_trim
